description: Wields psychic powers; unsettles minds.
Specialist in damage-dealing elemental spells.
Repels fiends, undead, and mind-preying horrors.
Alchemical serums transform the body for raw power.
Weaponizes disease against enemies.
Reanimates a corpse-wrought creature to fight.
Brews elixirs; boosts healing and spell damage. A supportive potion-maker.
Wears Arcane Armor: Guardian (durable frontline) or Infiltrator (stealthy ranged).
Commands an Eldritch Cannon for area damage, force, or protection.
Fights beside a Steel Defender; makes INT-based weapon attacks.
A stitched Undead companion with modifications, Jolt to Life revives, free Raise Dead at 15.
Tool Proficiency: Proficiency with Smith's Tools (or another Artisan's Tool if you already have it).
Tool Proficiency: Proficiency with Tinker's Tools (or another Artisan's Tool if you already have it).
Roars a ferocious, thunderous challenge at enemies.
Infernal fury wreathed in hellfire.
Rage triggers random magical effects; some benefit allies.
Ancestral spirits punish foes that ignore you; shields allies from harm.
Spiked armor deals damage on grapple and charge (dwarves).
Grows natural weapons (claws, tail, bite) that change each rage.
Frenzied melee with bonus attacks. Simple, aggressive, high damage.
One of 70+ subclasses; draconic might and elemental breath.
One of 40 dark-fantasy subclasses; grows stronger as it breaks.
Grows to Large, hurls boulders, channels elemental giant might.
Channels Haze energy; shapes fear and madness, resists mutation.
Unstoppable forward momentum; shoves, knocks prone, and repositions foes.
Barbarian who insists he's a wizard. Ends in 'I Cast Fist!'
Champion of the old gods with inhuman, tearing strength.
Channels a bound primal spirit of Etharis.
Radiates a damaging elemental aura (desert / sea / tundra).

subclass: Path of the Totem Warrior / Wild Heart
description: Animal spirit boons (Bear = resistance tank, Eagle = mobility, Wolf = team).
Yggdrasil branches grant temp HP and teleport allies to safety.
Death-touched rage; endures beyond mortal limits.
Divine fury: bonus radiant/necrotic damage and cheap resurrection.
Saga maneuvers fueled by a maneuver point pool; Feral Celerity.
Permafrost: +1 AC while unarmored, Resistance to Cold damage, and Con mod times (min 1) per Long Rest you can extend a Rage that would end (no action) unless you are Unconscious.

Hellfire Claw: While raging one hand becomes a fiery claw: your first weapon hit each turn with that hand's weapon deals +1d6 fire, or if you dealt no such fire damage, a bonus action unarmed strike with the empty claw (bludgeoning or slashing) adds 1d6 fire.
Alchemical Experiments: Alchemist's Supplies with proficiency; craft Potions of Healing with them instead of an Herbalism Kit.
Shadow Smoke: While raging, smoke fills 10 feet around you; other creatures starting their turn in it have disadvantage on their next attack roll.
Rage of the Giants: When you activate Rage, if smaller than Large you can become Large (with your gear) if there is room.

source: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass
description: Belly Concoction: When you rage, pick a concoction (change each rage).

source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack
description: Galvanic Heart: Resistance to Lightning damage (if you already have it, also reduce Lightning damage by d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus).
Instinctual Divination: When you take the Study action to make an Arcana or Religion check, you can make it as a Wisdom (Survival) check instead.
Demontongue: You speak and understand Abyssal or Infernal (your choice).
Song of Creation animates objects and a helpful Dancing Item.
Agile, defensive movement-based bard; dodges and repositions.
A doomsday prophet; features focused on terrifying foes.
Unbeatable persuasion; never-wasted Bardic Inspiration.
Fey enchantment: enthralls foes and rallies allies with temp HP.
Cutting Words debuffs; extra skills and off-list spells. Versatile.
Songs for the dead; sombre, hymn-driven battlefield control.
Tales from the Dead deliver random spooky, useful effects.
Blade Flourishes turn performance into melee damage. Dashing duelist.
Weaves misfortune; converts others' failures into escalating power.
Combat bard: buffs allies with Inspiration and fights in melee.
Psychic blades, fear, and stealing a slain foe's identity. Sinister.
Inspired Eclipse teleports, Bardic Inspiration added to healing, druid lore and a healing Moonbeam.
Talented Adventurer: Learn one adventurer's talent, and one more at Bard levels 6 and 14.
Antagonistic Antics: Learn Vicious Mockery (or another Bard cantrip if you have it; it doesn't count against your cantrips) and always have Dissonant Whispers prepared.

source: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2
description: Persona Masks: Own three masks (four at Bard 6, five at 14), swapping one per Long Rest; put on or switch one as a Bonus Action; remake a lost one in 8 hours.
Fast Movement: +10 feet Speed (+15 at Bard 6, +20 at 14).

Coin Flip: A creature using your Bardic Inspiration can flip a coin instead of rolling: heads it counts as the maximum; tails the GM keeps the die to boost a creature of their choice later (lost on your long rest).
Handy Haints: When you give Bardic Inspiration, summon a haint around the target for 1 minute with a 15-foot aura (it ends when you use its Reaction).

Dancing Shadows: As a bonus action spend a Bardic Inspiration for a 20-foot sphere of shadows around you for 1 minute: allies inside have half cover and outsiders have disadvantage on Perception into it (darkvision doesn't help).

source: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1
description: Malleable Visage: Proficiency with surgeon's tools, which can be your spellcasting focus.

source: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2
description: Culinary Exploration: Proficiency with cook's utensils, which can be your spellcasting focus; double proficiency bonus on checks using them to prepare food.
Poetic Provocation: You always have Vicious Mockery prepared (or learn another cantrip if you know it).

source: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass
description: Tools of Performance: craft theater masks (Fish, Fox, Old Man, Protagonist, and more) that grant abilities while worn.
Tragic Hero: When you fail a save, other creatures you choose within 60 feet add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) to their saves against the same effect.
Bonus Proficiencies: Choose three, each once: a gaming set, a martial weapon, Herbalism Kits, Thieves' Tools, a skill, or two languages.
Broad Inspiration: Learn Guidance (doesn't count against cantrips).
Bonus Cantrip: Learn one Sorcerer cantrip (it counts as a Bard cantrip but not against your known cantrips), and you can use a Wand, Rod, or Orb as your Bard focus.
Bonds with a monster; the companion type IS the subclass (Ferocity system).
Anti-undead specialist; amplified Crimson Rite and extra crit damage.
Controlled werewolf transformation with claws and regeneration.
Brews alchemical mutagens to tailor the hunter each day.
Blends blood magic with warlock spellcasting and a pact.
Channel Divinity reshapes spells (temp HP or a save penalty); Wizard cantrips; free Dispel Magic after healing.
Firearm-flavored domain using the Gunpowder exploding-dice property.
Hemocraft cleric; bends blood and curses the wounded (self-sacrifice).
Necrotic specialist; extra necrotic damage on cantrips.
Crafts and blesses armor and weapons; very durable.
Punishes wounded foes; efficient healing and cheating death.
Skills, languages, and mind-reading. The scholar-cleric.
The premier healing domain; maximizes restoration spells.
Radiant fire damage and Warding Flare defensive reactions.
Cycles lunar phases for buffs and battlefield control. Well-balanced.
Druid-flavored cleric: charms beasts, some armor and control.
Commands an ally to strike; charm and lockdown magic.
Emboldening Bond links allies for shared defense. Top-tier support.
Burns out rot and disease, whatever the cost.
Thunder and lightning; maximize damage with Channel Divinity.
Illusions, a duplicate, and blessings of stealth.
Twilight Sanctuary aura grants darkvision and temp HP. Elite protector.
Bonus attacks and combat buffs. The front-line cleric.

Eldritch Domain Spells: Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 Detect Thoughts, Tasha's Hideous Laughter, See Invisibility, Sleep; 5 Fear, Tongues; 7 Confusion, Phantasmal Killer; 9 Contact Other Plane, Dream.
Inquisition Domain Spells: Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 See Invisibility, Silence; 5 Dispel Magic, Remove Curse; 7 Arcane Eye, Locate Creature; 9 Creation, Hallow.

source: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2
description: Chromatic Affinity: On each Long Rest pick Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison; your Cleric spells and features can deal it instead of Necrotic or Radiant.

Astral Domain Spells: Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 Blur, Guiding Bolt, Invisibility, Longstrider, Starry Wisp; 5 Blink, Slow; 7 Banishment, Dimension Door; 9 Teleportation Circle, Wall of Force.

Festus Domain Spells: Domain spells at cleric levels: 1st goodberry, purify food and drink; 3rd heat metal, protection from poison; 5th create food and water, stinking cloud; 7th blight, control water; 9th cloudkill, contagion.
Community Almanac: Herbalism Kit with proficiency, plus Nature or Survival.

Domain Spells: Domain spells at cleric levels: 1st command, hunter's mark; 3rd calm emotions, warding bond; 5th beacon of hope, spirit guardians; 7th death ward, guardian of faith; 9th hallow, telepathic bond.
Domain Spells: Domain spells at cleric levels: 1st bane, false life; 3rd blindness/deafness, darkness; 5th blink, fear; 7th black tentacles, greater invisibility; 9th cone of cold, dream.

source: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2
description: Domain Spells: Domain spells at cleric levels: 1st entangle, longstrider; 3rd locate animals or plants, pass without trace; 5th conjure animals, haste; 7th freedom of movement, locate creature; 9th commune with nature, hold monster.
Domain Spells: Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 Augury, Bane, Bless, Warding Bond; 5 Bestow Curse, Counterspell; 7 Death Ward, Divination; 9 Commune, Modify Memory.
Apocalypse Domain Spells: Always prepared at Cleric levels: 3 Darkness, Hellish Rebuke, Phantasmal Force, Thunderwave; 5 Doom, Fear; 7 Blight, Ice Storm; 9 Antilife Shell, Insect Plague.
Domain Spells: Domain spells at cleric levels: 1st bless, goodberry; 3rd aid, heroism; 5th beacon of hope, spirit guardians; 7th banishment, faithful hound; 9th mass cure wounds, telepathic bond.
Domain Spells: Domain spells at cleric levels: 1st sleep, veil of dusk; 3rd darkness, moonbeam; 5th nondetection, globe of twilight; 7th divination, stellar bodies; 9th dream, seeming.
Mind Domain Spells: Always prepared: Command, Detect Thoughts, Dissonant Whispers, Mind Spike (3); Clairvoyance, Fear (5); Confusion, Phantasmal Killer (7); Synaptic Static, Telekinesis (9).

Commerce Domain Spells: Always prepared: Augury, Charm Person, Comprehend Languages, Locate Object (3); Glyph of Warding, Tongues (5); Divination, Leomund's Secret Chest (7); Legend Lore, Rary's Telepathic Bond (9).
Two things: bees and teamwork. Swarms and coordinated tactics.
A fallen druid corrupted by Delerium.
Fey hearth of healing and short-range teleportation. Nurturing.
Necrotic Halo of Spores; raises fungal zombies.
Starry Form flips between ranged damage, healing, and utility.
Bonds a wildfire spirit for fiery damage and healing bursts.
Draws on blight and undeath; necrotic and spectral effects.
Bonus spells keyed to terrain; the caster-focused druid.
Powerful, high-HP Wild Shape combat forms.
Aura of wind and water buffets nearby enemies.
Spirit totems buff summoned creatures and allies.
Circle of Blood Spells: Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Blood Rush, Crimson Lash, Sense Lifeblood; 5 Blood Bond, Sanguine Poppet; 7 Circle of Scarlet, Dark Sacrament; 9 Dominate Person, Mortality.
Catastrophic Power: After each Short or Long Rest pick one until the next rest.
Circle Forms: Wild Shape max CR equals Druid level / 3 (round down), Beast attacks deal +2 damage, and you can Dash, Disengage, or Influence as a Bonus Action.

source: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2
description: Circle of the City Spells: Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Grease, Jump, Shatter, Spider Climb; 5 Meld into Stone, Sending; 7 Fabricate, Stone Shape; 9 Animate Objects, Passwall.
Improved Shillelagh: Shillelagh works on any melee weapon you hold, which can keep its own damage die, and any proficient weapon can be your Druid Spellcasting Focus.
Draconic Lore: Learn Draconic, and add PB (double if proficient) to History checks about dragons.

Circle of the Old Ways Spells: Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Ancestral Communion, Barkskin, Shield of Faith, Shillelagh, Spike Growth; 5 Magic Circle, Plant Growth; 7 Freedom of Movement, Private Sanctum; 9 Awaken, Tree Stride.
Bewitched Effigy: As a Bonus Action spend a Wild Shape use to set a Small wicker effigy within 30 feet for 1 minute (AC 15, HP 5 x Druid level, Vulnerable to Fire) with a 30-foot dimly lit aura.

Umbral Form: As a bonus action spend a Wild Shape use to become smoky shadow for 10 minutes, keeping your statistics: Hide as a bonus action in dim light or darkness, squeeze through 1-inch gaps, and a reaction deals cold damage equal to PB to a creature you see hit you in melee.

source: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1
description: Circle Spells: You learn the swarm cantrip.
Mantle of the Wolf: As an action, expend a Wild Shape use to manifest a spectral wolf's head for 10 minutes (ends if dismissed, re-manifested, or you are Incapacitated).

source: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass
description: Petal Dance: As a bonus action, spend a Wild Shape use to wrap yourself in a petal cloud for 1 hour: +1 AC; a bonus action ranged spell attack within 30 feet for 1d6 slashing (2d6 at 5th, 3d6 at 11th, 4d6 at 17th); and a reaction to reduce damage to you or a creature within 10 feet by your druid level + Wisdom modifier, which disperses the cloud.

source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack
description: Circle of Symbiosis Spells: Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Arm Cannon, Calcified Memories, Fractured Shell, Phalangeal Shot, Shillelagh; 5 Displacing Maw, Osseous Impalement; 7 Dread Scarecrow, Maiden of Bones; 9 Forest of Dread, Tree Stride.
Circle of the Symbiote Spells: Always prepared at Druid levels: 3 Barkskin, Entangle, Guidance; 5 Plant Growth; 7 Hallucinatory Terrain; 9 Tree Stride.

Skin of Steel: In Wild Shape: max CR equals Druid level / 3; AC is 15 + Wisdom modifier if higher; Resistance to Poison and Advantage on saves against Poisoned; no Exhaustion from hunger, thirst, or suffocation, no need to sleep, and immune to magical sleep.

Circle of Cycles Spells: Always prepared: Augury, Evolution/Devolution (3); Clairvoyance, Tongues, Meld into Stone (5); Legend Lore, Contact Other Plane (9); Find the Path, Contingency, Flesh to Stone, Circle of Death (13); Foresight, Glibness, Time Stop (17).
Arcane Shots add damage plus banish, charm, restrain, blind, or blast; utility ammunition and evasive returns.
Superiority-dice maneuvers for damage and control. Tactical.
Marks and locks down foes; excels mounted.
Improved critical range; simple, durable, reliable damage.
Battlefield leader who directs and empowers allies.
Delving specialist; sniffs out danger and kicks down doors.
Summons a spectral echo to attack from and swap places with.
Fighter with abjuration and evocation magic; bonded weapons.
Psionic energy for force damage, defense, and movement.
Rallies and buffs allies; a light warlord.
Giant runes grant boons and let you grow to Large.
Fighting Spirit grants advantage and temp HP. Relentless.
Despairing Strike dice add psychic damage and debuffs, a fear-teleport on Tactical Shift, and a damage-negating shade form on Action Surge.

Protective Taunt: Once per turn when you hit with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, the target has Disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until the start of your next turn (one taunt per creature).
Compound Creator: Learn three compounds (two more at Fighter 7, 10, and 15, swapping one each time).
Skilled Guardian: Expertise in one skill you're proficient in, plus proficiency in two of Deception, History, Insight, Intimidation, Investigation, Perception, or Stealth.
Saga maneuvers fueled by a maneuver point pool; Stance of the Blade Breaker.
Agent of Mercy: Mercy Dice: three d6 (four at Fighter 7, d8s at 10, five at 15, d10s at 18), regained on a Short or Long Rest.

Launch: Three times per short or long rest (four at 7th, five at 15th), as a bonus action leap up to 15 feet in any combination of directions (30 at 7th) without provoking, reducing any fall after by 30 feet.
Death Knight: Draugr Dice: four d6 (six d8 at Fighter 5, eight at 9, eight d10 at 11, ten at 13, twelve d12 at 17); regain one on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest; save DC 8 + Con mod + PB.
Seaborne: Advantage on Strength and Dexterity saves and checks to avoid being pushed, knocked Prone, or moved against your will, and on checks to pilot waterborne vehicles.
Cat Whisperer: You can understand and talk with felines, use any Influence action skill option with them, and have Advantage on those checks.

source: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass
description: Arcane Quirk: Choose harmless quirks from your fused spirit, such as First Age gadgets glitching, coughing bubbles, or floating when unconscious.

source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack
description: Blood Strike: Learn three Blood Strike options (one more at levels 5, 9, 13, and 17; swap one each time).
Bolstering Presence: At the start of your turn (no action), creatures of your choice within 30 feet that see or hear you regain 2d6 + half your Fighter level Hit Points.
Bonus Proficiency: Proficiency in Deception, Insight, Intimidation, Sleight of Hand, or Stealth, or Thieves' Cant.
Spellcasting: Intelligence-based.
Firearms specialist base class with grit and trick shots.
Adds Eldritch-Knight-style infernal spellcasting to the martial base.
Mobile duelist; hooks and drags foes across the field.
Charm, the Charmed condition, and social dominance.
Heavy armor; commands allies to strike and endures brutal punishment.
Stealthy assassin with brimstone teleport strikes.
Deduction, skills, and mystery-solving base class.
Bare-knuckle brawler path.
Reworked elemental monk with reach and area effects.
Sorcerer third-caster; trades strikes for cantrips and spells; converts slots and Focus Points.
Hands that heal allies or deal extra necrotic. A medic-assassin.
Stealth, darkness, and shadow teleportation. The ninja.
Magic-wielding monk blending ki and spellcraft.
Draconic elemental breath and a protective aura.
Manifests spectral arms and body; WIS-based reach attacks.
Extracts knowledge by striking; the studious library-monk.
Evasive, unpredictable movement; hard to pin down.
Spends ki on elemental 'spells' for ranged effects.
Weapon-focused monk with ranged shots and agile defense.
Feeds on nearby death for temp HP; frightens foes.
Flurry can push, trip, or deny reactions. The classic martial artist.
Ranged radiant bolts and burst attacks.
Ranged ki-infused archery monk.
Subtle Hand: On your turn your Unarmed Strike reach is +5 feet, and Unarmed Strikes from the Attack action can deal Psychic damage.
Tall Tales: Proficiency in Deception, Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion.
Shade of Regret: Once per turn, spend 1 Focus Point (no action) to create an intangible shade within 10 feet until the end of your next turn.

source: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack
description: Combo: When an Unarmed Strike hits and deals damage, spend 1 Focus Point: your Unarmed Strikes get +2 to hit this turn, rising by 2 per further hit (max +6).
Celestial Connection: Telepathy with any creature within 30 feet that knows a language (one-way).
Spirit Strike: Any unarmed strike can instead be a proficient melee spell attack with 30-foot reach using Wis for attack and damage, dealing your Martial Arts die of force.
Contagious Discipline: Your Unarmed Strikes can deal Slashing, and Flurry of Blows hits add a Martial Arts die of Necrotic.
Wise Words: Proficiency in Performance and Persuasion, and use Wis instead of Cha for Charisma-based skill checks.

source: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass
description: Herding Sheep: As a bonus action, spend ki to move a willing creature you can see within 60 feet without provoking opportunity attacks: 15 feet per ki point toward you or 10 feet per point in another direction, up to its speed.

Guardian of the Way Technique: Once per turn when a Flurry of Blows Unarmed Strike deals damage: Anchoring Strike (the target can't teleport or travel between planes until the end of your next turn) or Banishing Strike (teleport the target up to 15 feet to a space you can see).

Martial Form: At the start of your turn, spend 1 Focus Point to adopt a form for 10 minutes: Forged Heart (Unarmed Strikes crit objects; Flurry hits force a Strength save or push 15 feet), Nightmare Shroud (Deflect Attacks forces a Wisdom save or the attacker is Frightened until the end of its next turn), Traveler's Blade (+10 feet reach), or Weretouched (dropping an adjacent enemy to 0 grants temp HP of a Martial Arts die + Monk level).
Heavy-armor bruiser who challenges the toughest foes in melee.
Consumes slain foes to gain terrifying mutations.
Arcane power to strike monsters and the mages behind them.
Patient gadgeteer; leverages traps to stay ahead of prey.
Fear and dominance; punishes frightened enemies.
Holy warrior; Sacred Weapon smites and protective auras.
Athletic champion; buffs party speed and mobility.
Witch-sworn paladin who curses sworn enemies.
A plague-ridden oath; spreads sickness to enemies.
Pacifist protector; redirects and absorbs incoming harm.
Focused single-target hunter with huge burst damage.
Fey-touched; resistance auras and great durability.
Champion of the realm; binds foes to attack you.
Elemental riders on Divine Smite, Cha-based unarmored AC, elemental resistance aura, flight at 20.
Freedom of the seas; a bit of everything - AoE, mobility, control.
Hunts aberrations and casters; anti-magic tools.
Fallen paladin; commands undead under an aura of hate.

Frenzied Slaughter: Spend a Channel Divinity as a Bonus Action to frenzy until the end of your next turn: when you miss with a melee weapon or Unarmed Strike, take a Reaction to attack again, and Advantage on saves against Charmed, Frightened, and Stunned.

Mark of the Heretic: Spend a Channel Divinity as a Bonus Action to mark a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute: your weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks against it crit on 19-20, and when it starts its turn in your reach you can take a Reaction to attack it.

source: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack
description: Oath of Revelry Spells: Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Charm Person, Hideous Laughter; 5 Enhance Ability, Hangover; 9 Create Food and Water, Hypnotic Pattern; 13 Charm Monster, Freedom of Movement; 17 Geas, Telepathic Bond.

Oath of the Hearth Spells: Always prepared at Paladin levels: 3 Burning Hands, Find Familiar; 5 Aid, Continual Flame; 9 Beacon of Hope, Daylight; 13 Fire Shield, Guardian of Faith; 17 Flame Strike, Rary's Telepathic Bond.

Oath Spells: Oath spells at paladin levels: 3rd bane, detect magic; 5th arcanist's magic aura, hold person; 9th dispel magic, slow; 13th dimension door, resilient sphere; 17th dominate person, scrying.

Castigate: Spend a Channel Divinity as a Magic action: up to Cha mod creatures within 30 feet make a Str save or are shackled in fire with Speed 0 for up to 1 minute (repeat save each turn); a Bonus Action flares the shackles for 2d6 Fire each.

source: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1
description: Tenets of the Harvest: Share Your Meal, Nurture Over Cure, Permit Prosperity.
Tenets of Valhalla: Protect the worthy dead.

source: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass
description: Tenets of the River: The River Flows On; The River Quenches or Drowns; The River Rages; The River Seeks the Sea, Always.

source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack
description: Tenets of the Eldritch Hunt: Resolve, Respect, Responsibility.
Tenets of the Guardian: Choose up to four ideals matching your alignment, such as Courage, Sacrifice, Service, Fidelity, Protection, Affinity, Beauty, Freedom, Dominance, Opportunism, or Profit.
Grit-fueled unarmed brawler; a signature Sterling Vermin creation.
Fights alongside a loyal animal companion.
Raises a drake companion; rideable at high level.
Fey charm, extra psychic damage, and social skills.
Ambush king: massive first-round burst and darkvision.
Monstrous Favored Enemy transformation with an AC bonus, a frightening aura, retaliatory strikes and self-healing.
Planar warrior; force damage and short teleports.
Flexible combat picks tuned for single foes or hordes.
Marks a foe to exploit; strong against casters.
A magical swarm harries foes and moves the ranger.
City-bound ranger who rains death from the rooftops.
Commands diseased rats and swarms for the greater good.
Cold damage that ignores resistance, Hunter's Mark temp HP, stunning reaction, a freezing ghost form.
Envenomed Attack: Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action, poison a weapon or up to 20 ammunition for 1 minute: +1d4 Poison on hits.

Elemental Arrows: Wis mod times (min 1) per Long Rest, as a Bonus Action imbue a Longbow or Shortbow for 1 minute: it deals Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder instead of its normal type plus 1d6 of that type.

source: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2
description: Lycanthrope: Claws: Unarmed Strikes can use Dex and deal 1d6 + Str or Dex mod Slashing.
Pin Down: Once per turn on a weapon or Unarmed Strike hit, add 1d6 of the attack's type and cut the target's Speed by 10 feet until your next turn.
Rocborne Magic: Bonus ranger spells known at ranger levels: 3rd feather fall, 5th gust of wind, 9th lightning bolt, 13th ice storm, 17th legend lore.
Grim Harbinger Spells: Always prepared at Ranger levels: 3 Bane; 5 Hold Person; 9 Fear; 13 Intrusive Despair; 17 Dream.

source: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2
description: Trapper's Tools: Proficiency with thieves' tools and double proficiency bonus when using them to disarm or manipulate traps.

source: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass
description: 1st Manifestation: Taking damage grants a curse marker (two on a critical hit), lasting until the end of your next turn, up to a maximum of 2 (3 at 5th level, 4 at 11th, 5 at 17th).

source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack
description: Tools of the Trade: Proficiency and Expertise with Torture Tools and Insight.
Trail Warden Spells: Always prepared at Ranger levels: 3 Goodberry; 5 Pass Without Trace; 9 Spirit Guardians; 13 Guardian of Faith; 17 Mass Cure Wounds.
Bloodhound Spells: Always prepared: Alarm (3), Hold Person (5), Clairvoyance (9), Locate Creature (13), Scrying (17).
Ranged Specialist: Training with all ranged weapons (including thrown weapons and firearms), and no Disadvantage on ranged attacks for an enemy within 5 feet.
Enchantment and illusion magic plus Mage Hand trickery.
Devastating surprise-round burst; disguises and poisons.
Reads tells for reliable Sneak Attack and insight.
Help action at range; intrigue, tactics, and forgery.
Death-touched; borrows skills and drops spectral tokens.
Teleporting strikes on Bloodied enemies, Dead Three resistances, Terrify Cunning Strike, damage aura.
Mobile skirmisher; free reactive movement and survival.
Secures the next big score; slippery and connected.
Psychic blades and psionic dice; stealthy and self-sufficient.
Espionage rogue who reads and tracks foes.
Mobile duelist; lands Sneak Attack solo, no ally needed.
Fast Hands and climbing; uses items as a bonus action.
A 'legally-distinct Spider-Man' rogue with webslinging mobility.
Hair Trigger: Proficiency with Blackpowder Pistols.
Evil Eye: As a Bonus Action curse a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute (one at a time); you can Sneak Attack it whenever you don't have Disadvantage.

Spellcasting: Third-caster Wizard spellcasting with Intelligence (Sangromancy spells count as Wizard spells): three cantrips (four at Rogue 10), prepared spells 3 at level 3 rising to 13 at level 20, and slots per the Eldritch Knight-style table (two 1st at level 3 up to one 4th at level 19).

source: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack
description: Webbing: As a Bonus Action produce webs lasting 1 minute: zip to a point within 30 feet without provoking (or as a Reaction while falling, 10 feet any direction); manipulate or snatch an unattended object under 10 pounds within 30 feet; make an anchored 60-foot rope; or, twice per Long Rest (one back on a Short Rest), cast Web in a 5-foot Cube for 1 minute with DC 8 + Dex mod + PB.
Impressionist: Expertise with Calligrapher's and Painter's Supplies; conjure either kit plus ink or paint as a Magic action (they vanish if they leave you).
Medic: Medicine proficiency with double PB.
Hex Slinger: Cha mod times (min 1) per Short Rest, when you deal Sneak Attack damage designate two of the dice; their total sets a jinx until the end of the target's next turn.
Eyes in the Dark: Darkvision 120 feet.
Beyond Coincidence: You have Fortune Dice (d20s) equal to half your Rogue level (round up), regained on a Long Rest.

source: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass
description: Conjure Flame: You learn Dancing Lights (as floating candles) and Produce Flame.

source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack
description: Sanctified Champion: Proficiency with Martial weapons and training with Medium armor.

Shadowy Reflection: As a Magic action, detach your shadow into a space within 5 feet; later control it as a Magic action or with your Cunning Action, moving it your Speed to manipulate objects, open unlocked doors, or carry up to 10 pounds.
Psionic spells cast cheaply and subtly.
Order magic wards allies and cancels advantage/disadvantage.
Contaminated magic and mutation-fueled sorcery.
Borrows the cleric list; a flexible offense/support caster.
Draconic resilience (natural AC/HP) and elemental spells.
Shifts lunar phases to swap between spell suites.
Body-glowing runes charged by sorcery points (scales at higher levels).
Darkness, a Hound of Ill Omen, and cheating death.
Sorcery Point bursts of temp HP or radiant fire, healing spell list, Counterspell that refunds points.
Flight and wind mobility with thunder and lightning.
Chaotic surges; high-variance power and Tides of Chaos.

Apocalyptic Spells: Always prepared at Sorcerer levels: 3 Augury, Comprehend Languages, Hellish Rebuke, Ray of Enfeeblement; 5 Bestow Curse, Revivify; 7 Banishment, Divination; 9 Contagion, Insect Plague.

Haunted Spells: Always prepared at Sorcerer levels: 3 Bane, Chill Touch, Invisibility, See Invisibility, Unseen Servant; 5 Fly, Speak with Dead; 7 Death Ward, Greater Invisibility; 9 Little Death, Telekinesis.
Bad Luck Charm: Once per Short or Long Rest (or 1 Sorcery Point), as a Bonus Action a creature within 30 feet has Disadvantage on its next D20 Test before the start of your next turn.

source: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2
description: Heroic Spells: Always prepared at Sorcerer levels: 3 Arc Blade, Burning Blade, Frigid Blade, Heroism, Magic Weapon, Mirror Image, Shield; 5 Haste, Phantom Steed; 7 Death Ward, Stoneskin; 9 Legend Lore, Hold Monster.
Create Ice: Touching a surface, as a Bonus Action ice over five contiguous 5-foot squares as Difficult Terrain until the end of your next turn, plus five more per Sorcery Point.
Dunetreader: Sand difficult terrain doesn't slow you, and you tolerate heat up to 150 degrees Fahrenheit unprotected.
Blood Well: When you deal damage or restore HP, spend your Blood Well to add 1d8 for one target.
Trick of the Light: See normally in magical and nonmagical darkness out to 60 feet.

source: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2
description: Skinshifter Magic: Spells known at sorcerer levels (not counted against spells known): 1st chameleon skin, inflict wounds; 3rd barkskin, protection from poison; 5th vampiric touch, zippit!; 7th freedom of movement, frogskin; 9th feverskin, greater restoration.

Spirit Caller Spells: Always prepared at Sorcerer levels: 3 Bane, Bless, Heroism, Protection from Evil and Good; 5 Augury, Healing Spirit; 7 Speak with Dead, Spirit Guardians; 9 Aura of Life, Death Ward.

source: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass
description: Arcane Prison: Oni traits manifest by how many sorcery points you are missing (lost again as you regain them), each lasting until a long rest: 0 to 1 Eyes, 2 to 4 Horns, 5 to 9 Skin, 10 to 14 Tongue, 15+ Hair.

Innate Darkness Spells: Always prepared at Sorcerer levels: 3 Confounding Shadows, Darkness, Tide of Darkness, Umbral Tendril; 5 Fear, Shadowy Eruption; 7 Black Tentacles, Greater Invisibility; 9 Mislead, Summon Shadow.
Nemesis Spells: Always prepared: Compelled Duel, Mirror Image, See Invisibility, Shield (3); Counterspell, Slow (5); Fire Shield, Otiluke's Resilient Sphere (7); Circle of Power, Mislead (9).
Flexible occult caster who picks spell schools; Tapestry magic.
Psionic 'powers' with a Strain system; specializations include time and fire.
Dedicated protector with Guardian Tactics and Interrupt. A true tank class.
Your future self is the patron; foresight-flavored support.
Fey charm, fear, teleportation, and misdirection.
Radiant damage plus a pool of light healing.
A tentacle strikes for you; deep-sea magic.
Fire damage and temp HP on kills. Aggressive.
Elemental damage and a personal vessel sanctuary.
Telepathy and psychic domination of minds.
CHA-based weapon attacks; the definitive melee warlock.
Horror patron; frighten foes and deal necrotic.
Deathless endurance and self-healing.
A dying god's vestige fights, heals, or curses beside you; borrowed Cleric domain spells.

Coven Spells: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Hold Person, Identify, Locate Object, Ray of Sickness; 5 Bestow Curse, Counterspell; 7 Phantasmal Killer, Polymorph; 9 Divination, Locate Creature; 17 Contact Other Plane, Scrying.
Drain Life: After the Attack or Magic action, make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action dealing 1d6 + Cha mod Necrotic.

Spell Siphon: Right after a creature within 60 feet casts a spell, take a Reaction: it makes a Charisma save or can't cast that spell for 8 hours, and if it was level 1+ and a level you can cast, you have it prepared meanwhile.

source: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack
description: Future You Spells: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Accelerate/Decelerate, Delay, Enhance Ability, Moment to Think, Recall; 5 Protection from Energy, Slow; 7 Death Ward, Dire Warning; 9 Legend Lore, Telepathic Bond.

Astral Griffon Spells: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Identify, Locate Object, Magic Missile, Rope Trick; 5 Blink, Clairvoyance; 7 Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum, Leomund's Secret Chest; 9 Legend Lore, Passwall.

Expanded Spell List: Added to your warlock list: 1st entangle, magic missile; 2nd scorching ray, see invisibility; 3rd blink, nondetection; 4th arcane eye, black tentacles; 5th mislead, telepathic bond.

Great Fool Spells: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Disguise Self, Hideous Laughter, Rope Trick, Spiritual Weapon, Vicious Mockery; 5 Blink, Stinking Cloud; 7 Phantasmal Killer, Puppet Master; 9 Arcane Hand, Mislead.
Horned King Spells: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Animal Friendship, Bane, Spike Growth, Suggestion; 5 Bestow Curse, Fly; 7 Phantasmal Killer, Polymorph; 9 Dominate Person, Scrying.

Expanded Spell List: Added to your warlock list: 1st detect poison and disease, inflict wounds; 2nd ray of enfeeblement, silence; 3rd stinking cloud, vampiric touch; 4th greater invisibility, phantasmal killer; 5th cloudkill, contagion.

source: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 2
description: Expanded Spell List: Added to your warlock list: 1st heroism, sanctuary; 2nd enhance ability, enlarge/reduce; 3rd haste, spirit guardians; 4th black tentacles, freedom of movement; 5th contagion, dominate person.

Context Switch: When a creature makes a melee attack against you, take a Reaction to swap places with a creature within 5 feet (Wisdom save if unwilling); it becomes the target and takes the damage, and an enemy so targeted has Disadvantage on attacks until the start of your next turn.
Your Coven: Choose a coven: Crowsworn, Cloud Cap Coven, Fish Head Coven, League of the Gilded Gourd, Patchwork Robe Coven, or The Tall Hats.

source: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass
description: Expanded Spell List: Added to your warlock list: 1st Faerie Fire, Identify; 2nd Locate Object, Swallow Magic; 3rd Daylight, Nondetection; 4th Guardian of Faith, Locate Creature; 5th Create Spirit Train Stop, Tamh Gon's Fiery Festival Feast.

subclass: Exalted Assembly of the Feline Court
description: Feline Spells: Always prepared at Warlock levels: 3 Animal Friendship, Cat's Spring, Feather Fall, Feline Grace, Misty Step, Speak with Animals; 5 Haste, Phantom Panther; 7 Freedom of Movement, Dimension Door; 9 Feline Chaos, Telekinesis.
Eternity in Stone: Once per Short or Long Rest, when you reduce a creature to 0 HP, you can Petrify it and gain 1d10 + Warlock level Temporary Hit Points.
Battle-caster dealing guaranteed minimum cantrip damage.
New hex-based caster; one of 10 new base classes, each with 7+ subclasses.
Elf sword-mage; mobile, defensive melee spellcaster.
Dunamancy of time: manipulate initiative, saves, and slots.
Dunamancy of gravity: move, slow, and crush foes.
A sentient spellbook; swap damage types, awaken it.
Arcane Ward soaks damage; wards and dispels. Protective.
Arcane gunsmith wizard; fuses magic with firearms.
Hemocraft wizardry; sacrifice hit points for potent effects.
Bonus-action teleports and swaps; tougher, doubled summons; damage can't break Conjuration Concentration.
Portent replaces enemy or ally rolls; foresight.
Hypnotic Presence locks a target down; social skill boost; redirects attacks; erases memories.
Sculpt Spells shapes AoE around allies. The classic blaster.
Flexible, deceptive illusions you can reshape.
Free empowered Animate Dead, harder-hitting undead, necrotic resistance, exploding minions.
Transmuter's Stone party buffs, free Alter Self and Polymorph, upcast utility spells, Panacea.
Balances evocation offense with arcane self-defense.
Fair and Foul: On each Long Rest choose Arch Daemons or Arch Seraphs and you can prepare only that side's free spellbook spells.
Potion Craft: Proficiency in Medicine, Herbalism Kit, and Alchemist's Supplies.
Sangromancy Savant: Sangromancy spells count as Wizard spells.

source: Valda's Spire of Secrets: Player Pack 2
description: Magic Missile Savant: Magic Missile is free in your spellbook.
Arcane Artisan: Learn Mending (or another Wizard cantrip) for free.
Core Wand: Craft a personal wand that is your focus and can be summoned to your hand as a bonus action from anywhere (8 hours to remake).
Forbidden Knowledge: Learn Deep Speech or another language, and always have one level 1 Warlock spell prepared (swap on a Long Rest).
Alchemical Knowledge: Alchemist's Supplies with proficiency, usable as an Arcane Focus and to craft any magic item.
Shadow Symbiote: Darkvision 60 feet (or +60) and sight through magical darkness to 30 feet, but sunlight sensitivity (disadvantage on attacks and sight-based Perception in sunlight).

source: Heliana's Guide to Monster Hunting: Part 1
description: Biomancy Savant: Copying biomancy spells into your spellbook costs half the gold and time.

source: Obojima: Tales from the Tall Grass
description: An Arcane Art: As a bonus action, proficiency bonus times per long rest, fold an origami construct bound to you or a creature within 60 feet for hours equal to half your wizard level (AC your spell save DC, destroyed by any damage).

source: Steinhardt's Guide to the Eldritch Hunt Player Pack
description: Brittle Bone Armor: As an action without armor or Shield, gain Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Wizard level for 1 hour; while they last you have Resistance to Piercing and Slashing and +2 AC.
Book Learning: Touching a text for 1 minute grants a working knowledge of it unless coded.
